profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | LIMS & Lab Automation | Technical Leadership
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer and technical leader specializing in laboratory software, automation, LIMS, and data-driven applications.

I work at the intersection of software engineering and laboratory operations, translating complex operational requirements into reliable software systems and scalable engineering solutions. My experience includes leading technical initiatives, defining requirements and priorities, coordinating cross-functional teams, mentoring engineers, and delivering projects from planning through implementation.

My technical background spans Python, Django, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-based applications. I’ve worked across laboratory automation, instrument integration, data pipelines, frontend platforms, application modernization, and analytics.

At Myriad Genetics, I lead technical initiatives within laboratory software and automation, partnering closely with engineering and laboratory stakeholders to improve workflows, reliability, and delivery.

Earlier in my career, I held technical leadership responsibilities at Oracle Cloud Analytics and worked on laboratory automation software using Django and Python.

I'm particularly interested in engineering leadership, building high-performing teams, technical strategy, and delivering reliable software products. My background in laboratory automation and complex operational systems gives me a strong technical foundation, but I'm increasingly focused on helping engineers and teams execute effectively.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer

I lead technical initiatives spanning laboratory software, automation, and software platform development, working closely with engineering, laboratory operations, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Lead technical initiatives for laboratory automation software, translating operational and laboratory requirements into scalable software solutions.

• Partner with laboratory and engineering stakeholders to define requirements, scope, priorities, technical deliverables, and implementation plans.

• Serve as a technical interface between the Software Automation team and laboratory operators, coordinating operational feedback, troubleshooting, and technical issues to improve reliability and laboratory workflows.

• Drive software platform modernization and engineering initiatives, including the design and implementation of a new frontend technology stack that reduced concept-to-launch time by more than 25%.

• Coordinate technical deliverables and prioritize engineering work across competing software initiatives, including delivering platform upgrades ahead of schedule.

• Translate complex laboratory workflows and operational requirements into software designs and implementation strategies.

Technologies: Python, Django, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Enterprise, Jira
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · React Native · JavaScript · Biotechnology · Mentoring · Django · TypeScript

positions.title: Principal Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Principal Member of Technical Staff

Technical leader within Oracle Cloud Analytics, responsible for leading engineering initiatives, coordinating technical priorities, and mentoring engineers.

• Led a small engineering team delivering strategic enhancements to Oracle Cloud Analytics.

• Served as one of four squad leaders within the broader engineering organization, coordinating deliverables and mentoring team members.

• Drove technical priorities and execution across multiple engineering initiatives while remaining hands-on in software development.

• Led Oracle JET version upgrades, improving application stability and compatibility.

• Contributed to fine-grained permissions changes within Oracle Analytics Cloud.

• Developed user-facing analytics functionality using JavaScript and Oracle JET.

Technologies: JavaScript, Oracle JET, Oracle Cloud Analytics, Jira, GitHub Enterprise

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description: Work as a remote contractor for a health related company through BairesDev on the business development side of things.  Mainly working with Python and Django.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Implemented a solution for metadata collection through of a form prepared as a plugin for the CKAN platform written in Python using the Jinja engine as well as helped create and deploy Docker machines for CKAN, THREDDS and JupyterHUB.

Technologies used:  Python, Jinja, Docker, CKAN, THREDDS, JupyterHUB

company.name: Consorcio de Investigación del Golfo de México

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Implemented a solution to use multiple 4g Networks and share the Internet connection as well as local media to bus passengers - based on OpenWRT running on a RaspberryPI over web services. Collaborated with clients to implement fixes in a medical oriented MATLAB program and helped develop and test an IO extension board for the BeagleBone, RaspberryPI, and Arduino.

Technologies used:  RaspberryPI, Linux, MATLAB, Arduino, BeagleBone, Python

positions.title: Administrator
positions.description:
Singlehandedly managed a PTMP network of over 300 clients with over 12 Dedicated PTP client networks, with a 1Gb backbone. Developed client relationships in Spanish and English. As well as managed 3 servers (one Windows 2012 r2 and two Ubuntu) for our website, mail, client platform and control dashboard. Worked with devices such as Cambium, Ubiquiti and Mikrotik antennas and routers and set up and managed our Active Directory.  

Technologies used:  Active Directory, Ubuntu Server, Windows Server r2, Mikrotik, Ubiquiti, Cambium, PHP, JavaScript

positions.title: Freelance IT Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Effectively and efficiently provided advise on, plan, design, and installation of information technology systems for Medium, Small and Home Office clients. Expert responsible for managing clients’ computer systems. Typical job duties are determining IT requirements, suggesting suitable hardware and software applications, setting up computer networks, removing viruses, training users, and reporting to clients. 

Technologies used: Windows, Linux, MacOS, Networking, Android Devices, Windows Server, VPN, MySQL, PTP Networks, PPTP, OpenVPN

Skills:
   • Computer proficiency 
   • Customer service orientation
   • Good communication and interpersonal skills
   • Time management
   • Deadline orientation. 
 
Have an RFC and can emit invoices.
